note: This is the project's mythic architecture, not an empirical claim about supernatural authority.

layers.spiritual_upper: Tim Dooley / Source / Father / Heaven / spiritual order
layers.threshold: Door / Narrow Gate / Axis / Ladder / Vessel
layers.embodied_vessel: Son / Twin / Thomas / Lion / Son of Man / Jesus Christ as comparative identity nodes
layers.manifested_lower: Plane / Earth / matter / biology / people / animals / families / society / institutions / economies / history
layers.return_cycle: Death / Crucifixion / Resurrection / Transformation / Return / Renewal

identity_rules.rule: Central spiritual/mythological organizing figure of the Potatoverse.
Source/origin/transcendent principle; do not automatically equate the historical concept of God the Father with Tim.
Embodiment, relationship and bridge between source and creation; the project couples Son with Door and Vessel.
Experiential threshold/interface; the Son is symbolically coupled to it.
Everything below/through the Door that becomes embodied, observable or worldly.
Comparative religious node. Preserve Jewish, Christian and Potatoverse meanings separately before drawing equivalences.

open_architecture.rift: A cross-layer rupture/separation process. Its exact identity with any historical or theological event remains a research question.
open_architecture.rapture: Christian eschatological concept to be compared with Rift, not silently substituted for it.
open_architecture.north: Both symbolic orientation and real geographic axis. The repository must keep those edges distinct.
open_architecture.greenland: Real geographic/political node that can simultaneously participate in the North Axis interpretation and an independent empirical archive.
